# Page 1
Form 6251
Alternative Minimum Tax - Individuals
Header: Part I Alternative Minimum Taxable Income
- 1: Enter the amount from Form 1040, line 11b
- 2e: Add lines 2a through 2d
- 4: Alternative minimum taxable income
Header: Part II Exemption
- 5: Exemption amount
- 6: Subtract line 5 from line 4
- 7: If line 6 is zero or less, enter -0-
